description: This file defines thread-safe mechanisms for calling and storing results of functions that interact with Python's Global Interpreter Lock (GIL). It includes classes for managing call-once semantics both globally and per-interpreter, with support for subinterpreters. The code handles thread synchronization, interpreter-specific storage, and safe initialization of Python objects in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: gil_safe_call_once_and_store
classes.description: A class template that manages call-once initialization and storage of a result, supporting both global (single interpreter) and interpreter-specific storage depending on subinterpreter support.

classes.name: call_once_storage
classes.description: A helper struct for storing the call-once result and synchronization primitives when subinterpreter support is enabled.

methods.name: call_once_and_store_result
methods.description: Initializes the stored result by calling a provided function once, with thread safety and GIL management.

methods.name: get_stored
methods.description: Retrieves the stored result after initialization.
